expressions.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: expression exploration sheet for a beloved children's game companion, exactly THREE full-body rune foxes in a single horizontal row of three equal square cells.
Input image: reference for orange fox identity, cyan runes, cream chest, black nose, single curled tail, lifted front paw and illustrated fantasy game rendering ONLY. Replace the hostile face completely.
Primary request: redesign this as an irresistibly friendly, cute fox friend for very young children. Large OPEN warm amber eyes with round pupils and clear catchlights; relaxed gently arched upper eyelids and eyebrows, NEVER a sharp V. Soft short rounded muzzle, tiny kind smile, fluffy round cheeks, inquisitive ears. No teeth, no scowl, no sideways suspicious squint. Playful inviting curiosity, never aggressive.
Keep the same new canonical body anatomy, scale, left-facing three-quarter camera, lifted near front paw, three planted paws, one plush tail curling up at right, proportions, orange/cream palette and compact cyan runes across all three. Only expression nuances: LEFT calm affectionate small closed-mouth smile; MIDDLE curious delighted open eyes with tiny open smile and softly attentive ears; RIGHT playful happy tiny smile with slightly raised cheek. All three have both eyes open. Do not make three different ages or species.
Style: polished hand-painted premium fantasy game sprite, beautifully shaded orange fur, cream chest and tail tip, crisp readable silhouette, tasteful cyan magical markings on forehead and flank. Broad simple shapes readable at 128px. Larger head and softer anatomy than the source, but unmistakably a fox, not a cat or dog. No armor, wings, crowns, extra tails or jewelry.
Layout: panoramic 3:1 sheet, exactly three equal square cells, centered fox in each cell; matching baseline and head height, 15 percent transparent safety margin on every side including tail/ears/paw. Entire fox visible. No overlap between cells.
Transparent background with genuine alpha, no checkerboard, ground, cast shadow, scenery, border or divider. No lettering, labels, numbers or watermarks. Children cannot rely on reading; expression must communicate kindness visually. This is source artwork; all UI frame, labels and hit areas are separate runtime layers. Preserve one shared visual system; do not bake any controls into the image.
